_about.guide.on: 1: the paths are read through the stage tables (divine_paths/*.json: one step at a time, optional bonuses, one next-step card). 0: the old hand-written stage lists only (emergency switch; cards say not available). (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.bonus.on: 1: a stage's optional bonus is shown and paid once when it is met. A bonus never gates a stage. 0: no bonuses. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.bonus.tpPercent: Scales every bonus's TP (units of the base TP of a foe). (default 100, 0 to 300)
_about.bonus.pollTicks: Ticks between two looks at an online player's bonuses (one player per tick slot, so the cost does not grow with the player count). (default 200, 40 to 2400)
_about.standins.relief: Angel stage 6, rescue abroad when planet missions are absent: 0 off (the line says the missions are not available), 1 auto (the Relief abroad stand-in is offered while the missions are absent; with no stand-in built the line is waived, as before), 2 always (either counts). (default 1, 0 to 2)
_about.standins.ferry: Same for Whis's ferry against space travel (read by the stand-in package). (default 1, 0 to 2)
_about.npc.on: 1: NPC stand-ins for the roles other players would fill (NPC disciples of a Kai, the god's own person as the linked partner, NPC students and pilgrims of an Angel). 0: none of it, on every world. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.npc.mode: 0: stand-ins off everywhere. 1: in solo worlds only (an integrated server not opened to LAN). 2: also on servers, as the slower route (they come after npc.serverWaitMinutes with no eligible real player online). (default 1, 0 to 2)
_about.npc.serverWaitMinutes: Mode 2: minutes with no eligible real player online for a role before its stand-in may come. (default 10, 1 to 120)
_about.npc.serverPayPercent: Mode 2: the pay of a stand-in route on a server, in percent of the real-player rate (solo worlds pay 100). (default 50, 0 to 100)
_about.npc.disciples: NPC disciples a Kai may hold at once (real disciples take the three places first). (default 3, 0 to 3)
_about.npc.discipleLessonsPerDay: NPC disciple lessons per path day that pay the Kai; more are still taught. (default 4, 0 to 12)
_about.npc.godBondCap: The most the bond with the god's own person can reach (50 is Sworn: no Life Link, no One Will). (default 50, 0 to 75)
_about.npc.godBondPerDay: Bond the god's own person gives per path day. (default 3, 0 to 10)
_about.clock.playTime: 1: the Kai, Angel and Destroyer paths count PLAY time - their days, hours, rests, waits and daily limits pass only while players are online, one path day in clock.dayMinutes of play. 0: real days and hours of the wall clock, as before 0.4. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.clock.dayMinutes: With clock.playTime on: minutes of play one path day lasts (20 = one Minecraft day; a 7-day wait is then 2 h 20 min of play, an hour about 50 seconds). (default 20, 1 to 1440)
_about.hosts.on: 1: the host-bound alternatives of the stage bonuses (an awakened or rebuilt world, a plea a God of Destruction granted, a world won through planet missions, a siege won, a colony held; data/dmzultra/divine_paths/host_rows.json). 0: the bonuses read as the plain tables. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.hosts.war: 1: the colony-war alternatives (a siege won, a colony held) count once the colony war is installed (until then they are not available and the bonus falls through). 0: they are left out. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.guide.sync: 1: the next-step cards are sent to a player's client when they change (path screen, tracker, Track). 0: no card is sent; the old path screens work as before. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.guide.refreshTicks: Ticks between two looks at the card of a player who is tracking a step. (default 100, 20 to 600)
_about.intro.on: 1: the introduction scenes of the Kai and Angel paths exist (opt-in per player, watchable any time). 0: none, and no request is answered. (default 1, 0 to 1)
_about.intro.offerOnOath: 1: the oath plays the introduction when the player's own choice allows it (it never does until they choose it). 0: only on request. (default 1, 0 to 1)
